## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

input.title: Combo-Fighters VFX/Art Import — Status Brief for Leonard (Feb 28, 2026)
input.bodyText:
COMBO-FIGHTERS VFX / ART IMPORT — STATUS BRIEF
Prepared by: Victor Barnes (Engineering) | Date: Feb 28, 2026
For: Leonard Hayes | Re: "Marcus says the import PR is covered by the merged VFX branch — treat the draft as parked"

=====================================================================
BOTTOM LINE
=====================================================================
Parking the DRAFT import PR is fine — it is literally empty. But do NOT
treat the VFX work as landed/covered. Most of it is NOT in the mainline
build. Only two VFX pieces actually reached the develop line. The big
"vfx updates" branch is stranded on a diverged side-branch, and the full
art import lives only on a long-running branch that has never merged down.
Recommendation: park the draft, but keep the VFX-implementation items OPEN
and owner-assigned. This is the same shape as the placeholder-asset ship
we had before.

=====================================================================
1. WHAT ACTUALLY MERGED INTO MAINLINE (develop -> main)  [DONE]
=====================================================================
- PR #33 "Tiles Combo Highlight" -> develop, merged 2026-01-26.
  Real VFX: BoardOutlineManager.cs, BoardVFXCell.cs, FireElectricBeam &
  UI_GlowGradient shadergraphs, Lana Studio Hyper Casual FX package.
- PR #16 "Win Screen Coin VFX" -> develop, merged 2025-12-21. Real coin VFX.
- Supporting art/anim in develop: #22 Ground Shadow, #27 girl color texture,
  #19 combo-changed anim sequence.
These are the only VFX/art items confirmed in the develop/main line.

=====================================================================
2. VFX THAT DID **NOT** REACH MAINLINE (counts as still open)
=====================================================================
- PR #36 "vfx updates" -> merged into the `playable` branch on 2026-02-11.
  Real VFX (bloom post-processing volume, material fixes; Flare/Hit_Spikes/
  ImpactFlare/Spark materials, Brick shader).
  PROBLEM: `playable` is DIVERGED from develop (27 commits ahead / 40 behind)
  and has never been merged down. CodeRabbit review was SKIPPED because the
  base was not the default branch — so it merged with no line-by-line review.
  => "Merged" on paper, but NOT in the shipping line.
- PR #7 "Electric beam & generator" -> merged only into the import branch
  (Marcus/ImportingArtAssets), not develop/main. Electric VFX not in mainline.

=====================================================================
3. THE DRAFT IMPORT PR (the thing to "park")
=====================================================================
- PR #1 "Marcus/importing art assets" (Marcus/ImportingArtAssets -> main):
  OPEN, DRAFT, label "do not merge". Files changed against main = 0
  (verified: 0 additions / 0 deletions / empty file list).
  => The draft PR contains NO code. Parking it is harmless; nothing ships
     from it. It is a placeholder/empty draft — recommend we formally decide
     to close it out.
- The Marcus/ImportingArtAssets branch itself accumulated art work (#3, #5,
  #6, #11, #12, #13) plus periodic develop syncs (#2, #4, #25). Two attempts
  to re-sync develop into it were closed unmerged (#10, #32). The branch has
  NEVER been merged into develop/main, so the bulk import (characters,
  enemies, "lots of vfx from the other project") is NOT in mainline.

=====================================================================
4. ROADMAP CROSS-CHECK (Zombie Match 3D board)
=====================================================================
VFX-implementation card "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation"
is marked complete at the card level, but its "Workflow" checklist still
has BOTH items OPEN:
   [ ] Marcus to create VFX

**Engineering reconciliation — Combo-Fighters VFX/art import (Victor Barnes, 2026-02-28)**

Logging the real state of the Combo-Fighters VFX/art work here since this is our open VFX-integration tracking ticket. Reconciled from the repo, not from PR titles.

**Landed in mainline (develop→main):**
- PR #33 "Tiles Combo Highlight" (BoardOutlineManager/BoardVFXCell, FireElectricBeam & UI_GlowGradient shaders, Lana Studio FX) — merged to develop 2026-01-26.
- PR #16 "Win Screen Coin VFX" — merged to develop 2025-12-21. Plus supporting art (#22 shadow, #27 texture, #19 combo anim).

**NOT in mainline (still effectively open):**
- PR #36 "vfx updates" (bloom volume, material fixes, Flare/Hit_Spikes/ImpactFlare/Spark mats, Brick shader) merged into the `playable` branch only. `playable` is diverged from develop (27 ahead / 40 behind) and was never merged down; CodeRabbit review was skipped (non-default base). This VFX is stranded off-mainline.
- PR #7 "Electric beam & generator" merged only into the `Marcus/ImportingArtAssets` import branch, not develop/main.

**Import branch / draft:**
- PR #1 "Marcus/importing art assets" (import→main) is an OPEN draft labeled "do not merge" with **0 files changed** against main (empty). The import branch has never merged to develop/main, so the bulk import (characters, enemies, imported VFX) is not in the shipping line.

**Owner:** the art/VFX PRs are authored by the GitHub account "Marcus" (login PERSON_0396, no email on GitHub); behavior/branch-naming ties it to **Marcus Bennett** (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co), NOT the separate `marcus@harmonygames.co` or Marcus Lee records. Integration/merges by **Oliver Brooks**.

**Net:** parking the empty draft PR is fine, but the VFX is not "covered/landed." Open decisions: merge-down or abandon `playable` (PR #36) with a real review, and decide the fate of the never-merged import branch. Keeping VFX-implementation items open until they appear on develop/main.

Still needs owner attention:
- VFX creation for item-infusion: Marcus Bennett (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co) — the art-side "Marcus", not marcus@ or Marcus Lee.
